title: saṃkhitta sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Vesālī,
in the hall with the peaked roof in the Great Wood.
Then Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī approached the Blessed One,
paid homage to him, stood to one side, and said to him:

“Venerable sir, it would be good if the Blessed One would teach
me the Dhamma in brief, so that, having heard the Dhamma from the Blessed One, I might dwell alone, withdrawn, diligent, ardent, and resolute.”
